collectionCount.description: How many records the account holds in one collection.

count.description: How many records it holds there.

main.description: Counts the records the asking account holds in each dev.knotless.* collection, read from its PDS rather than the index, and names its repositories, public and private, with how many other accounts push to or read each: what dev.knotless.deleteAccountData would delete, as `knotless account delete-data` lists it. A private repository's records are in its space, counted as one space. Only the account itself, logged in to this appview's web pages, can ask: the appview reads its spaces with the session it keeps for it, which the pages' session cookie names.

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

collections.description: Each dev.knotless.* collection the account holds records in, in the order of their names.

repos.description: The account's repositories, public ones first, each by name.

spaces.description: The spaces the account owns for private repositories: one for each, and one for each name a rename of one left.

repoData.description: One of the account's repositories, and how many other accounts it concerns.

collaborators.description: The other accounts its record lets push to it.

members.description: For a private one, the other accounts that read it, its runners left out.

name.description: Its name, its dev.knotless.repo record's key.

private.description: Whether it is private, in a space of its own.

description: What knotless data the asking account holds, before it deletes it.
